description: Planning cases; no provider coverage or completed tests implied

cases.test_case: Buyer opens wallet flow on target phones
cases.expected_evidence: Wallet launches from the agreed browser or app surface and the buyer can return or resume the order

cases.test_case: Buyer cancels or closes the wallet before completion
cases.expected_evidence: Order stays unpaid or pending and can be resumed according to the provider contract

cases.test_case: Provider confirms payment while buyer never returns
cases.expected_evidence: Verified status or callback updates the correct order once

cases.test_case: A callback is repeated or received out of order
cases.expected_evidence: No duplicate fulfillment and later processing respects the provider’s state rules

cases.test_case: Payment succeeds but notification is delayed
cases.expected_evidence: Status query and follow-up preserve the order reference without asking the buyer to pay again

cases.test_case: Refund is initiated and later confirmed
cases.expected_evidence: The merchant can distinguish initiation from the final outcome and reconcile the refund reference

cases.test_case: One approved test payment to a third-party wallet
cases.expected_evidence: Merchant reference provider reference principal fee and reported outcome can all be matched

cases.test_case: Create request times out with no response
cases.expected_evidence: Lookup and the documented retry procedure resolve the original request without a second disbursement

cases.test_case: Transfer is still processing past the expected time
cases.expected_evidence: The team can query or escalate the same transaction and retain the current pending status

cases.test_case: A transfer fails or is reversed
cases.expected_evidence: The cause and each resulting debit credit or unresolved item can be accounted for

cases.test_case: One line fails within a test batch
cases.expected_evidence: The batch report retains per-transfer outcomes and retry affects only eligible items

cases.test_case: Provider report and internal ledger disagree
cases.expected_evidence: The merchant can identify the missing entry and explain principal fees and any reversal
